system.description: In place of an attack made as a result of the attack action, you can spend 1 Martial Die to instead strike a pressure point meant to induce sleep. If the target creature is an Elite or Solo adversary or they are of a higher level than you, they are immune to this technique. Roll your Martial Die, multiplying the result by 10. If the final value is more than or equal to the targets current hit points you knock them unconscious for the next 10 minutes. The creature is awoken if moved, they take damage, or another creature uses its action to wake it. A creature becomes immune to this technique for 8 hours after it is used against them regardless if it succeeded or not.

roll.note: At or above its current HP: unconscious for 10 minutes.
